result.title: VISTA: A Framework for Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness
result.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Magazine, 2026
result.summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming intelligent transportation systems by connecting roadside cameras, edge computing units, vehicles, and traffic infrastructure into a shared sensing and decision-making ecosystem. However, transmitting raw traffic video over vehicle-to-everything (V2X) links is bandwidth-intensive, while deploying large multimodal models directly on resource-constrained vehicles is often impractical. To address these limitations, this article proposes VISTA (Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness), a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines predictive video representation learning with lightweight language-based reasoning to provide communication-efficient traffic situational awareness. In the proposed architecture, roadside surveillance units employ the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) and an attentive-pooler module to convert traffic video clips into compact future-scene embeddings. These embeddings are transmitted through V2X links to vehicle-mounted systems, where a TinyLlama small language model, enhanced with a custom visual adapter, interprets the embeddings alongside natural-language (NL) traffic queries. VISTA enables vehicles to obtain interpretable traffic information, reason about upcoming scene dynamics, and identify potential collision risks without receiving raw video streams. Experimental results in a digital-twin urban traffic environment show that VISTA achieves 97.77% accuracy and an 89% F1 score for future collision prediction while reducing the communication payload by several orders of magnitude compared with raw RGB video transmission. These results demonstrate the feasibility of embedding-based multimodal intelligence for low-latency, communication-efficient, and safety-oriented IoT-enabled transportation systems.

AI.brief_summary: 面向车联网交通态势感知，提出 VISTA：路侧端用 V-JEPA 加 attentive pooler 把交通视频压成未来场景嵌入，经 V2X 传给车载 TinyLlama 加视觉适配器，结合自然语言查询做可解释的碰撞风险预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测式视频嵌入作为压缩视觉状态、再交由语言模型解读」的做法，可供核查 VLM 推理中视觉证据如何被筛选与传给 latent 工作区的线索；但应用目标为通信效率，而非推理性状态生成。
